The slot therefore documents the mechanic and prices Searing Brilliance only.

Withheld, not called no_damage, on three counts. The engine's only WINDOWED attack-speed path resolves its window start by walking cast_order to the Q slot, so it is Q-slot-only (the Miss Fortune W precedent) and a P-slot steroid cannot reach it.
